title: 花旗集团CEO范洁恩如何赢得特朗普青睐
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: city groups Jane Fraser has pulled off a major political pivot. The big bank CEO has quietly won over President Donald Trump, navigating Washington's divide to chart a reputational comeback
segments.zh: 花旗集团CEO范洁恩完成了重大政治转向。这位大银行CEO悄然赢得了特朗普总统的青睐，在华盛顿的分裂中为美国第三大银行重塑声誉。
